gui.shadowedhearts.rules_presets.colosse: Nature-weighted Hyper Mode, 90-power Shadow Rush with recoil and boosted critical hits, unlimited Shadow PP, original Colosseum roster gauges, individual walking progress, deferred growth, and Relic Stone purification.

Scents calm modes; ordinary items are refused in Hyper Mode. Chamber purification, Shadow TMs and custom item benefits are disabled. Explicit gauge overrides remain; saved Pokemon are not rewritten.
gui.shadowedhearts.rules_presets.xd.desc: Species-based Reverse Mode, two to four random Shadow moves retained until purification, unlimited Shadow PP, 80% growth, original XD roster gauges, individual walking progress, calming scents, and both purification routes.
gui.shadowedhearts.rules_presets.xd.note: Shadow assignments remain random; purification restores native ordinary moves. Friendship starts below 80% gauge, or 60% for items; purification adds 70 friendship. Ordinary items are refused in Reverse Mode. Shadow TMs and custom item benefits are disabled. Reverse gauge bands are configurable approximations. Explicit gauge overrides remain; saved Pokemon are not rewritten.
gui.shadowedhearts.rules_presets.go.desc: Flat 20% extra damage dealt and taken, Frustration on new corruption, event-controlled Frustration removal, Return on purification, normal growth and evolution, and visible stats. Shadow trading remains blocked.
gui.shadowedhearts.rules_presets.go.note: Minecraft adaptation: native turn-based move effects, NPC snagging, Heart Gauge care, Relic Stones and chambers remain. Stardust/Candy costs, purification stat/level bonuses and GO's battle system are not added. Frustration removal starts closed and must be enabled by the server. Applying this preset does not rewrite existing Pokémon or automatically purify them.
